findings_closed.title: Exact/min ATHTransferRequestMintUsername values could be accepted by the source wallet but fail before Registry
findings_closed.resolution: ATHWallet owner-facing notify and mint paths now require downstream notify value plus ATH_NOTIFY_OWNER_REQUEST_EXEC_RESERVE. Regression proves 35M/36M/37M do not debit source ATH, while 50M reaches Registry and finalizes a name.

findings_closed.title: Username mint overpayment could be trapped in the official Registry ATH wallet
findings_closed.resolution: Already covered by the current bounded ATHWallet owner-facing mint path: source wallet forwards only canonical downstream value and refunds owner excess. Existing production-wallet test keeps official Registry ATHWallet TON balance below 0.01 TON even with a 0.25 TON request.

contract_changes: ATHWallet notify downstream execution reserve increased to 7,000,000 nanotons and owner-facing notify/mint first-hop reserve set to 10,000,000 nanotons.
covered_flows: 35,000,000 nanotons owner request value does not debit source ATH or create a Registry record.
36,000,000 nanotons owner request value does not debit source ATH or create a Registry record.
37,000,000 nanotons owner request value does not debit source ATH or create a Registry record.
50,000,000 nanotons owner request value reaches user ATHWallet -> official Registry ATHWallet -> UsernameRegistry -> UsernameNFTItem deploy/ACK and finalizes the record.
Overpay request value remains bounded by existing ATHWallet excess refund behavior.

verification.focused_tests: npm.cmd run test:file -- tests\username-registry-ath-wallet-integration.test.ts tests\username-registry-paid-mint.test.ts tests\username-registry-refund-flush.test.ts tests\username-registry-due-flush.test.ts tests\username-registry-prune-pending-mint.test.ts tests\username-nft-item.test.ts tests\ath-wallet-boundary-negative.test.ts tests\vault-ath-integration.test.ts

production_note: ATHWallet code hash changes in this milestone. This locks the UsernameRegistry -> ATHWallet -> UsernameNFTItem seam behavior after the prior ATHWallet exact-value forwarding and owner-excess refund fixes.
